decision_context.metric_values_source: Parent-provided development summaries; no new data-independent evidence claimed

caveat: Development-only split robustness, not independent validation. All 400 rows informed historical feature/model/recipe choices. Kernel inner CV controls only current bandwidth/alpha choices. Exact/D4 groups do not verify source family independence. Conditional bootstrap omits fitting/selection uncertainty; the two partitions reuse the same observations. No holdout evaluation. The original CNN seed, compact panel, averaging and D4 hypotheses were explored on reused development data. These new partitions evaluate robustness, not independent confirmation. Primary recipe is fixed before training. Do not select the best split, initialization seed, or secondary endpoint.
